thread:
elaine: Heads-up — opened a quick PR to clarify our audit-log retention phrasing and to add an SDK v3 snippet that shows redaction + retention TTL. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 :link:
samir: thanks! can you paste the exact new sentence you want for the SOC2 section? legal tends to prefer conservative wording here.
elaine: current draft: 'Audit logs are retained for a configurable period for operational and compliance purposes. We retain minimal identifying data and support configurable redaction.'
elaine: i was thinking: 'Audit logs are retained for a configurable retention period (default 365 days) to support operational troubleshooting and compliance obligations. Sensitive identifiers are redacted by default; customers can configure retention and redaction via the Console or API.'
samir: that sounds reasonable. maybe avoid giving a hard default in the public docs? we do have default in product but legal may want it left out of public-facing compliance page.
jake: +1 on conservative phrasing. Suggested final: "Audit logs are retained for a configurable retention period to support operational troubleshooting and compliance obligations. Sensitive identifiers are redacted by default; customers can configure retention and redaction through the Console or the Audit Logs API." keeps it noncommittal about exact days but clear.
maria: PR also included an SDK example for v3 showing how to set retention and enable redaction. paste from PR:

```
# python example (redwood-sdk v3)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

client.audit_logs.update_policy(
    project_id="proj_123",
    retention_days=365,
    redact_sensitive=True
)
```

maria: can we add a note that the SDK call is only available to org admins? otherwise customers might try and fail.
elaine: good call. added a parenthetical in the snippet caption: "(requires org admin permissions)". also fixed the link anchor that was broken in the header — was pointing to #audit-log-retention-old.
docs-bot: PR 4823: CI passed, docs lint ok, staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/audit-logs?pr=4823 :white_check_mark:
owen: one small nit from legal: avoid the phrase "minimal identifying data" — they want us to use "only data necessary for service operation and compliance". can you swap that phrasing and ping legal when updated?
elaine: swapped wording to match legal. updated PR with the admin note and new phrasing. pinging @jake for final sign-off.
jake: looked at the updated preview — wording is clean. approve from legal side. :thumbsup:
samir: awesome. i'll merge after a tiny docs style pass (short sentence on the top). thanks everyone — i'll follow up if anything in staging shows odd rendering.
elaine: thanks team! I'll add a short migration note in the SDKs page about v2->v3 call differences (param names changed from ttl_days -> retention_days) before merge. :rocket:
